te-en: Namaskaram! Nenu Vaani, AI assistant ni. Mee ki emi help kavali?
Hello andi! Nenu Vaani, oka AI assistant. Restaurant table aa, doctor appointment aa, cheppandi.
Namaskaram, Vaani ni, AI assistant. Emi chesi pettamantaru?
hi-en: Namaste! Main Vaani hoon, AI assistant. Bataiye, kya madad karoon?
Hello ji! Main Vaani, ek AI assistant. Table book karna hai ya doctor ka appointment?
Namaste, main Vaani hoon, AI assistant. Aaj kya kaam hai?
en-IN: Hello! I'm Vaani, an AI assistant. How can I help you today?
Hi, this is Vaani, an AI assistant. Restaurant table or doctor's appointment?
Hello, I'm Vaani, your AI assistant. What can I do for you?

te-en: Ae area lo chudamantaru? {area_1} aa, {area_2} aa?
Area cheppandi andi, {area_1} leda {area_2}?
Ekkada kavali, {area_1} side aa {area_2} side aa?
hi-en: Kaunse area mein dekhoon? {area_1} ya {area_2}?
Area bataiye ji, {area_1} ya {area_2}?
Kahan chahiye, {area_1} side ya {area_2} side?
en-IN: Which area should I check, {area_1} or {area_2}?
Which area works for you, {area_1} or {area_2}?
Where would you like it, {area_1} or {area_2}?

te-en: Ae roju, ennintiki kavali?
Date, time cheppandi andi.
Eppudu kavali, ee roju aa repu aa? Time entha?
hi-en: Kis din aur kitne baje chahiye?
Date aur time bata dijiye.
Kab chahiye, aaj ya kal? Kitne baje?
en-IN: Which day and what time?
What date and time should I look for?
When would you like it, today or tomorrow? What time?

te-en: Enthamandi vastunnaru?
Mottham enthamandi andi?
Table enthamandi ki kavali?
hi-en: Kitne log aa rahe hain?
Kul kitne log honge?
Table kitne logon ke liye chahiye?
en-IN: How many people?
How many of you will be coming?
The table is for how many people?

te-en: Booking evari peru meeda cheyyali?
Mee peru cheppandi andi?
Peru cheptara, booking ki?
hi-en: Booking kis naam se karoon?
Aapka naam bata dijiye?
Naam kya likhoon booking pe?
en-IN: What name should I put the booking under?
May I have your name, please?
And the name for the booking?

te-en: {area} lo moodu manchi options unnai: {options}. Edi kavali?
Choodandi, {options}. Veetilo edi nachindi?
{area} lo top moodu: {options}. Edi book cheyyamantaru?
hi-en: {area} mein teen achhe options hain: {options}. Kaunsa pasand karenge?
Dekhiye, {options}. Inmein se kaunsa?
{area} ke top teen: {options}. Kaunsa book karoon?
en-IN: Here are three good options in {area}: {options}. Which one would you like?
I found {options}. Which one works?
The top three in {area} are {options}. Shall I book one?

te-en: {time} ki full ayipoyindi andi. {alternatives} ki undi, edi okay?
Sorry, {time} slot full. {alternatives} kudirithe chudandi.
{time} ki ledu andi, kani {alternatives} ki khaali undi.
hi-en: {time} baje full hai ji. {alternatives} pe jagah hai, kaunsa chalega?
Sorry, {time} full ho gaya. {alternatives} chalega?
{time} nahi mil raha, lekin {alternatives} khaali hai.
en-IN: Sorry, {time} is full. I have {alternatives}. Would either work?
{time} is taken, but {alternatives} are free.
That slot's full. How about {alternatives}?

te-en: {date} {time}, {business}, {party_size} mandi, {name} garu peru meeda. Confirm cheyyana?
Okasari cheptanu: {business}, {date} {time}, {party_size} mandi, {name} garu. Ok na?
{name} garu, {business} lo {date} {time} ki {party_size} mandi. Book cheyyana?
hi-en: {date} {time}, {business}, {party_size} log, {name} ji ke naam pe. Confirm karoon?
Ek baar check kar lijiye: {business}, {date} {time}, {party_size} log, {name} ji. Theek hai?
{name} ji, {business} mein {date} {time} baje {party_size} log. Book kar doon?
en-IN: {business}, {date} at {time}, {party_size} people, under {name}. Shall I confirm?
Just to check: {business}, {date}, {time}, {party_size} people, for {name}. Okay?
{name}, that's {business} on {date} at {time} for {party_size}. Book it?

te-en: Ayipoyindi! Booking ID {booking_id}, details WhatsApp lo pampanu. Inka emaina kavala?
Done andi! Mee booking ID {booking_id}. WhatsApp lo message vastundi.
Book chesanu andi, ID {booking_id}. Details WhatsApp lo unnai.
hi-en: Ho gaya! Booking ID {booking_id}, WhatsApp pe details bhej di hain. Aur kuch?
Done ji! Aapka booking ID {booking_id} hai. WhatsApp pe message aa jayega.
Book ho gaya, ID {booking_id}. Saari details WhatsApp pe hain.
en-IN: Done! Your booking ID is {booking_id}, and I've sent the details on WhatsApp. Anything else?
All set, booking ID {booking_id}. You'll get a WhatsApp message shortly.
Booked! ID {booking_id}. The details are on WhatsApp.

te-en: Oka second andi, check chestunna…
Okka nimisham, chustunna…
Aagandi, available unda ledha chustanu…
hi-en: Ek second ji, check kar rahi hoon…
Bas ek minute, dekh rahi hoon…
Ruko zara, availability dekhti hoon…
en-IN: One second, let me check…
Just a moment, checking that for you…
Hold on, let me look that up…

te-en: Sorry andi, sariga vinapadaledu. Inkosari cheptara?
Kshaminchandi, malli cheppagalara?
Konchem clear ga cheptara andi?
hi-en: Sorry ji, theek se suna nahi. Ek baar phir bolenge?
Maaf kijiye, dobara bataiye?
Thoda saaf bolenge ji?
en-IN: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?
Sorry, could you repeat that?
I missed that, could you say it once more?

te-en: Hello, vinipistunda?
Hello andi, unnara?
Hello? Naa maata vinipistunda andi?
hi-en: Hello, sunai de raha hai?
Hello ji, aap hain?
Hello? Meri awaaz aa rahi hai?
en-IN: Hello, can you hear me?
Hello, are you still there?
Hello? Can you hear me okay?

te-en: Inka emaina help kavala?
Inkemaina chesi pettala andi?
Vere emaina kavala?
hi-en: Aur kuch madad chahiye?
Kuch aur karna hai ji?
Aur koi kaam?
en-IN: Anything else I can help with?
Is there anything else?
Can I help with anything else?

te-en: Thank you andi, manchi roju! Bye.
Sare andi, untanu. Take care!
Call chesinanduku thanks andi, bye!
hi-en: Shukriya ji, aapka din achha ho! Bye.
Theek hai ji, dhyan rakhiye. Bye!
Call karne ke liye thank you, bye!
en-IN: Thank you, have a great day! Bye.
Take care, bye!
Thanks for calling, bye!

te-en: Sorry andi, ee demo lo {area_1}, {area_2} lo matrame chudagalanu. Vaatilo okati chudamantara?
{heard} lo ippudu ledu andi, {area_1} leda {area_2} lo chudana?
Prastutam {area_1}, {area_2} matrame andi. Andulo chudamantara?
hi-en: Sorry ji, is demo mein abhi sirf {area_1} aur {area_2} hain. Inmein se koi dekhoon?
{heard} mein abhi nahi hai ji, {area_1} ya {area_2} mein dekhoon?
Abhi sirf {area_1} aur {area_2} cover hain. Wahan dekhoon?
en-IN: Sorry, for this demo we only cover {area_1} and {area_2}. Shall I check one of these?
{heard} isn't covered yet. Shall I look in {area_1} or {area_2}?
Right now I can only book in {area_1} and {area_2}. Want me to check there?

te-en: Idi emergency laaga undi andi. Ventane 108 leda 112 ki call cheyyandi.
Please ippude 108 leda 112 ki call cheyyandi andi, idi emergency.
Emergency aithe ventane 108 leda 112 ki call cheyyandi. Nenu booking cheyyalenu.
hi-en: Yeh emergency lag rahi hai. Turant 108 ya 112 pe call kijiye.
Please abhi 108 ya 112 pe call kijiye ji, yeh emergency hai.
Emergency mein turant 108 ya 112 call kijiye. Main booking nahi kar sakti.
en-IN: This sounds like an emergency. Please call 108 or 112 immediately.
Please call 108 or 112 right now, this is an emergency.
For an emergency, call 108 or 112 straight away. I can't book for emergencies.

te-en: Sare andi, mana team lo okaru mee ki tvaralo call chestaru.
Ok andi, human ki connect chestanu, leda callback arrange chestanu.
Thappakunda, maa staff mee ki call back chestaru.
hi-en: Theek hai ji, hamari team se koi aapko jaldi call karega.
Ok ji, main aapko insaan se connect karti hoon ya callback arrange karti hoon.
Bilkul, hamara staff aapko call back karega.
en-IN: Sure, someone from our team will call you back shortly.
Okay, I'll connect you to a person or arrange a callback.
Of course, a staff member will call you back.

te-en: Nenu eppudu OTP, PIN, card number adaganu andi. Evariki cheppakandi.
Daya chesi OTP leda card details cheppakandi, avi naaku avasaram ledu.
Maaku OTP, CVV, account number emi avasaram ledu andi.
hi-en: Main kabhi OTP, PIN ya card number nahi maangti. Kisi ko mat bataiye.
Please OTP ya card details mat bataiye, mujhe unki zaroorat nahi.
Hamein OTP, CVV ya account number ki zaroorat nahi hai ji.
en-IN: I'll never ask for an OTP, PIN or card number. Please don't share them.
Please don't share OTPs or card details; I don't need them.
We never need your OTP, CVV or account number.
